digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler mode and advisory lock
propositions: Mode class inherits str and uses lexical comparison via functools.total_ordering, causing incorrect rank ordering where bootstrap-throttle should be higher than reconcile-check but compares false
Five-mode MODE_CAPS mapping (reconcile-check=0, dry-run=0, bootstrap-strict=10, bootstrap-throttle=100, live=None) must be preserved and directly tested
Advisory lock phase-gate must enforce rank ordering: equal target allowed, higher target blocked for gated_mode reconcile-check
Rich comparison operators in Mode must use explicit five-mode rank rather than inherited str lexical order
All persisted mode strings, CLI vocabulary, library values, and MCP payloads remain unchanged and backward compatible
